_comment: Example layout for build_map.py. Everything canonical (what exists, what contains what, which gate feeds which lane) is read from the vault's Locations/; this file holds only what the vault has no field for. Copy it to VAULT/_meta/map/layout.json and replace the fictional names with your campaign's. Systems missing from sector_positions are auto-placed next to their neighbours.

page._comment: Wording shown on the page. region must match the note name of the sector-level location, if there is one.
page.title: Example Star Map

inferred_routes.note: Rumoured by dockhands; no gate on the Cinder side has been seen.

anchors._comment: Station or gate name -> the body it sits beside, when only the prose says so.

traffic_profiles._comment: frontier | settled | hub | corporate; unlisted systems are settled.

keeper._comment: GM-only. Never shipped in a --player build. keyword unlocks the Keeper layer in the GM build (casual-proofing only).
